name: Basic Missle
axis_orientation: nose/seeker end is the front (+1), rocket motor end is the rear (-1)
operating_principle: A guided missile operates by using a seeker to detect the target, a guidance system to control its flight, a rocket motor for propulsion, and control fins for steering. The warhead contains the explosive payload.

components.description: The nose/seeker section contains the instrumentation and sensors used to detect and track the target.
The warhead section contains the explosive payload and fuzing system.
The guidance section controls the missile's flight and provides steering commands to the control fins.
The rocket motor provides propulsion for the missile.
The control actuation section consists of the control fins and their associated actuators.
